description: A pre-initialisation PHP script for Revive Adserver that performs system environment checks, including verifying system requirements, PHP functions availability, and configuration settings before allowing the application to run.

methods.name: RV_initialSystemCheck
methods.description: Checks system settings and displays problems if requirements are not met, terminating execution if issues are found.

methods.name: OX_checkSystemInstalled
methods.description: Determines if the system appears to be installed by checking for an upgrade file.

methods.name: RV_checkSystemInitialRequirements
methods.description: Verifies PHP environment meets minimum requirements, including functions, PHP version, and memory limits.
